chunks: They will exchange cups of wine free of (incitement to) pleasantry or sin.

key_terms.تَأْثِيمٌ: Causing sin or intoxication leading to sin

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between laghw and ta'thim in the context of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the perfection of Paradise's beverages, where the cups exchanged by the inhabitants are free from 'laghw' (idle talk or minor sins) and 'ta'thim' (causing minor sin or intoxication). This reflects the state of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, who enjoy pure, non-intoxicating drinks that enhance spiritual awareness rather than dulling it, contrasting with the intoxicants of this world.
